news.q: On Oct. 11, 2026, NASA's Perseverance set the record for the longest drive on another world. How many miles had it gone?
news.fact: 28.1 miles, edging Opportunity's 28.06, in about 5.5 years instead of nearly 15.

news.q: A famous train delayed by a solar storm was long dated to 1841. Scientists just re-dated it. What year was it really?
news.fact: The 16-minute delay on England's Bristol and Exeter Railway came on Oct. 18, 1848.

easy.q: How many countries are in South America?
easy.fact: French Guiana is there too, but it's part of France.

easy.q: How many feet apart are the bases in Major League Baseball?
easy.fact: The distance has held since the 1800s.

medium.q: How many U.S. states border Canada?
medium.fact: Alaska shares the longest stretch of the border.

medium.q: How many games in a row did Joe DiMaggio get a hit in 1941?

medium.q: In what year was Magna Carta sealed at Runnymede?
medium.fact: King John agreed to it under pressure from rebel barons. The Pope annulled it within months.

medium.q: In what year did Saturday Night Live premiere?

medium.q: How tall is Seattle's Space Needle, in feet?
medium.fact: It was built for the 1962 World's Fair.
